title: Daytona Beach Parasail
specs: Pregnant guests cannot parasail or ride on the boat (insurer policy)
Minors must have waivers signed by a parent or guardian
Singles, doubles, or triples — captain decides safest grouping day-of
includes: Crew shoots photos of your flight (photo package extra)
blurb: Guests reserve parasailing flights at various heights. Flights include a safety brief and life-vest fitting. Singles, doubles, or triples fly together as decided by the captain.
extraNote: Observers are $25 + tax at check-in, subject to availability, not bookable online · Photos are $40 for digital downloads sent to your phone at trip end · If weather cancels, choose reschedule or full refund · Across from the lighthouse at 4936 S Peninsula Dr, Ponce Inlet, FL 32127 · Year-round
